Phase 47: reviewer context parity — impl submission (round 1).

What changed:
- tagteam/headless.py: two optional blocks in the headless turn prompt, rendered by compose_prompt between arbiter interjections and the contract. (1) PROJECT CONTEXT — the project context file the provider's own CLI does NOT auto-load (PROVIDER_AUTOLOADS: claude→CLAUDE.md, codex→AGENTS.md; preference AGENTS.md then CLAUDE.md), capped at 12000 chars with a truncation notice. (2) CHANGE SURFACE — impl cycles only; baseline sha + up to 60 attributable paths from the existing cycle.compute_scope_diff, plus the literal git diff command. Both gathered in HeadlessTurn and passed as kwargs, so compose_prompt stays pure; both degrade to None on any failure — a turn never fails because context could not be assembled.
- tests/test_headless.py: 19 tests (provider/file selection matrix, empty/oversized context, plan-vs-impl gating, scope-diff failure → None, path cap, block ordering before the contract).
- docs/phases/reviewer-context-parity.md (design + rationale, incl. deliberately-not-done list) and roadmap entry.

Not changed: cycle.py (consumed as-is), watcher, gatekeeper, panel, SKILL.md.

Verification: gate: see entry @ f976afa (on_submit run). Not yet run: a live headless turn against a real repo — unit coverage only; if you want an end-to-end check, say so and I'll run one on aegis.

Branch: phase-47-reviewer-context-parity (PR follows).

GATE: PASS | gate could not complete after 2 attempts — reviewer, see report
previous attempts: a1: abandoned (runner gone: runner pid 78817 is dead); a2: abandoned (runner gone: runner pid 78124 is dead)

One required fix:

- `read_project_context()` catches only `OSError`, but `Path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` can also raise `UnicodeDecodeError`. A malformed/non-UTF-8 `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` therefore escapes `_run_attempt()` and aborts dispatch, contradicting the phase's explicit guarantee that project-context assembly degrades to `None` and never fails a turn. Reproduced locally with a two-byte `CLAUDE.md` containing `ff fe`. Catch the decode failure (preferably the relevant Unicode error rather than a blanket exception) and add a regression test proving invalid UTF-8 returns `None`.

Verification reviewed: `tests/test_headless.py` passes (131 passed). The recorded gate did not run the suite—both runners were abandoned/dead—so please let the on-submit gate provide a real result on resubmission.

Round 2 — addresses the one required fix.

Changed (commit 5375be4):
- tagteam/headless.py read_project_context(): `except OSError` → `except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError)`; a non-UTF-8 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md now degrades to None as the phase promises, instead of escaping _run_attempt() and aborting dispatch.
- tests/test_headless.py: test_invalid_utf8_context_degrades_to_none — writes b"\xff\xfe" as CLAUDE.md, asserts None.

Verification: focused run tests/test_headless.py 132 passed @ 5375be4 (131 + the regression test). Full suite: gate: see entry @ 5375be4 (on_submit run — the round-1 gate never actually ran; this one is the run on the record).
